title: Chapter 164 God General Shen Yi
content:
Chapter 164 God General Shen Yi

At this moment, the entire void became completely quiet.

Countless powerful people from the Divine Dynasty looked at the horrifying scene in front of them in amazement.

That terrifying red-eyed man died like this?

They didn't even see clearly how Lu Daosheng took action.

In the void.

Lu Daosheng seemed to have done something very trivial, and looked at Lu Xue calmly, and his cold face suddenly showed a loving smile.

"Xiaoxue, you have grown up."

When Lu Daosheng heard Lu Xue's words, Lu Xue's face turned slightly red.

"By the way, my mother,"

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly reacted.

Lu Daosheng looked deep in the void, his eyes pierced through the endless void, and it took him a long time to withdraw his gaze.

"Your mother is fine."

Lu Daosheng said with a faint smile.

Lu Xue felt relieved when she heard that her mother was safe and sound.

My question seems to be a bit redundant.

If something happened to my mother, would my father still stand here indifferently?

She had no doubt at all, as long as there was something wrong with anyone between her and her mother.

The whole world will suffer.

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly noticed Mr. Zhou, who looked a little sad.

"Dad, can you please help me?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned.

Looking at the sadness deep in the eyes of everyone around him, Lu Daosheng immediately understood something.

"Xiaoxue, even if you want the whole sky to turn over, your father can do it for you."

Lu Xue was moved and then told about the unknown boundary, the matter of God General Shen Yi.

"Dad, can you save him?"

I heard Lu Xue's words.

Everyone around was stunned.

What is the princess talking about this? Is it possible that people can be resurrected even if they die?

Even Your Majesty can't do such a thing.

Mr. Zhou's eyes were already moved to the point of redness.

"Your Highness, you have the intention, but General God is probably powerless to turn the world back."

Mr. Zhou choked up.

However, Lu Xue looked at her father and waited for her father's answer.

"Haha, I thought it was something."

"Xiaoxue is waiting, dad will go back."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand, and the space in front of him broke open independently.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng stepped in and disappeared from the spot.

But at this time everyone was completely confused.

"I, I heard it right."

Everyone was in a timid face.

They knew that His Highness’s father was not simple, after all, that was His Majesty’s man.

They were also obvious to all just now.

Faced with the terrifying existence above the half-step mortal realm, Lu Daosheng also easily killed it instantly.

However, the fact that it is really incredible to come back to life is really unbelievable.

At this time, Mr. Zhou slowly came to Lu Xue.

"Your Highness, this,"

He was shocked at this moment when what Lu Daosheng said just now.

Looking at Zhou Lai's inquiring gaze, Lu Xue smiled faintly and said, "Don't worry, Mr. Zhou, my father, he never lie."

On the side, Ao Qing suddenly appeared.

"Hey, you guys just take a look. This is not the first time my master is resurrecting."

Hearing this, everyone was shocked.

Could it be that God One can really be resurrected?

For a moment, everyone suddenly became expectant.

Because of God One's death, they could not forget it for a long time.

......

Buzz —

The space cracked and a figure slowly walked out of it.

Lu Daosheng looked at the scene in front of him and was immediately surprised.

I saw countless wreckage floating freely in the quiet void, as if telling the world that a great war broke out here not long ago.

Here is another unknown boundary.

Due to its unique geographical location, this place is not a good offensive direction.

But if this place is broken, the Divine Dynasty will be directly in a catastrophe.

Therefore, a force must be left here to guard it.

And this force must be able to trust 100%, and it must be strong.

In the end, Yan Lingyun chose Shenyi to guard here.

Everyone, including Yan Lingyun, did not expect that the Spirit-Devouring Clan would hide its strength and break this line of defense with half of its strength.

Standing in the void, Lu Daosheng slowly closed his eyes.

The next moment, the surrounding space began to fluctuate.

Buzz —

I saw that the things around began to change, and countless wreckage gradually recovered.

With a whoosh.

With a dazzling light flashing.

The entire void actually returned to its original appearance.

At this time, Lu Daosheng opened his eyes and immediately noticed the tiger and wolf army in the distance.

The leader is a man in armor.

His face was thin, but his eyes were extremely sharp.

At this time, the man in the armor was paying attention to the void barrier in the distance with a serious expression.

"General, what should I do now?"

A general came to the armored man and said with a heavy face.

Hearing this, the man in the armor slowly said, "Transfer the news from here back to the imperial capital."

"Then us?"

"Fight to the death."

Hearing this, the general was shocked and did not hesitate.

"Yes! General."

boom!

At this moment, a deafening roar came from afar.

The next moment, the void barrier that had been silent for endless years in the distance actually broke through a huge gap.

Extremely ferocious.

Seeing this, everyone looked solemn.

"Hehehehehehehehe, humble ants, be ready to be slaughtered!"

A sharp voice sounded from the depths of the void.

I saw countless strange figures began to surge out of the broken gap.

The number is almost continuous.

As the number of the Spirit-Devouring Clan increased, the faces of the people on the Divine Dynasty became more and more pale.

The man in the armor watched this scene and held the spear in his hand tighter.

"Tell me the order, everyone, return to the imperial capital!"

Faced with the countless Soul-Devouring Army, the armored man immediately changed his orders.

Hearing this, the general beside him was shocked and said, "General, are you retreating now? Are you some??"

However, the man in the armor said coldly: "I'll let you retreat!"

Hearing this, everyone immediately reacted.

"General!"

"General, don't, I am willing to fight side by side with you!"

Countless generals immediately stepped forward and asked for their orders.

There were even several iron-headed generals who directly wanted to compete with the Spirit-Eating Clan.

Faced with all this, the man in the armor looked a little ugly.

"This is a military order. I will not say it again, otherwise, behead!"

Finally, a tiger and wolf army guarding here for endless years began to retreat.

And at this moment, the dark and sharp sound rang again.

"Hehehehehehehehe, I just want to run away now, isn't it too late?"

boom!

Three terrifying auras suddenly soared out of the sky from the spiritual army.

Three powerful people in the mortal realm!

The man in the armor held a spear and walked slowly towards the entire Spirit-Devouring Clan. At the same time, a breath burst out from his body.

Ordinary realm!
